 Jordan Ellis Tue 20 October 2026 12:00 Follow us on Google Discover Lucero Acosta is making the most of a bad situation following her PFL debut. 
 The 32-year-old was stopped in the third round of her fight with Shannon Clark on Saturday night. 
 During the finishing sequence, Lucero Acosta went viral due to an unfortunate wardrobe malfunction that left one of her breasts exposed. 
 The OnlyFans star, who is sponsored by the content-sharing platform, subsequently suggested she’s banked a $500,000 bonus ‘because we showed our nipples’ at PFL Chicago.

— Kevin (@realkevink) October 19, 2026 View Tweet Why Lucero Acosta started fighting
 Lucero Acosta was 24 years old when she began learning how to defend herself after experiencing domestic violence.
 In 2019, a month after entering an MMA gym for the first time, ‘La Loba’ had her first amateur MMA fight.
 “I was married in California and suffered domestic violence,” Acosta said in 2025. 
 “My ex-husband was a police officer, he had a lawyer… I didn’t. The judge denied me a restraining order. 
 “I had to stay for the divorce proceedings, and I knew I had to learn to defend myself.
 “I was recommended a gym, I started training, and after a month, I was already fighting my first amateur bout.”
 View this post on Instagram View Instagram Post Lucero Acosta’s rise to prominence 
 The Mexican fighter turned pro during the same year and since then has amassed a 6-3 record. 
 Acosta has also earned over 500,000 followers on Instagram during her rise to prominence in MMA. 
 Content like her underwater bikini workouts went viral, bringing her a massive online audience. 
 An OnlyFans account was created in 2021, where Acosta charges fans $19.99 a month to access exclusive content. 
 A lucrative side hustle didn’t derail her career. In fact, Acosta won four consecutive fights in Combate Global. 
 Acosta capped off her run in Campbell McLaren’s promotion by outpointing Abril Anguiano in April 2025.
 After that, she was called up to the big leagues, and the rest, as they say, is history.
